title: chore: regenerate lock files - fix vulns
author: Kielek
body:
The goal was to improve current shape of vulnerable dependencies. Report AI generated

## Summary

| Metric | Before | After |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Distinct advisory groups across the repository | 31 | 4 |
| Subproject/advisory pairs | 74 | 5 |
| Subprojects with reported findings | 14 | 5 |

**27 advisory groups are no longer detected; 4 remain. No new advisory groups were detected.**

Matching GHSA and PYSEC records are counted once using the advisory groups returned by OSV. Multiple affected versions of a package within a subproject are also counted once. A shared advisory contributes one finding to each affected subproject, which explains the larger subproject/advisory totals.

## Results by subproject

| Subproject | Before | After | No longer detected |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Root tooling | 5 | 1 | 4 |
| agent | 19 | 0 | 19 |
| chatbot | 5 | 0 | 5 |
| checkout | 1 | 1 | 0 |
| email | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| flagd-ui | 4 | 0 | 4 |
| frontend | 3 | 0 | 3 |
| internal/tools | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| load-generator | 3 | 0 | 3 |
| mcp | 19 | 0 | 19 |
| payment | 3 | 0 | 3 |
| product-catalog | 1 | 1 | 0 |
| react-native-app | 4 | 1 | 3 |
| recommendation | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| shipping | 1 | 1 | 0 |
| telemetry-docs | 3 | 0 | 3 |
| telemetry (tests) | 3 | 0 | 3 |
| **Total subproject/advisory pairs** | **74** | **5** | **69** |

## Remaining findings

| Advisory | Dependency | Subprojects | Before | After | Action |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [GHSA-86w9-cpqp-85rv](https://osv.dev/vulnerability/GHSA-86w9-cpqp-85rv) | node-forge | react-native-app | Reported | Still reported | there is no fixed version |
| [GHSA-r3ph-w7gj-g6xm](https://osv.dev/vulnerability/GHSA-r3ph-w7gj-g6xm) | js-yaml | Root tooling | Reported | Still reported | bump blocked, markdown-cli should be released with new set of dependencies |
| [GO-2026-6443](https://osv.dev/vulnerability/GO-2026-6443) | google.golang.org/grpc | checkout, product-catalog | Reported | Still reported | I think it is wrongly detected, original report says that 1.84.0 is safe. We can manually bump to prerelease version/wait for official 1.85.0 |
| [RUSTSEC-2026-0258](https://osv.dev/vulnerability/RUSTSEC-2026-0258) | h2 | shipping | Reported | Still reported | Asked @cijothomas in private channel to check this, there is a fixed version of transitive dependency, but for some reasons it cannot be used |

## Findings no longer detected

| Advisory records | Dependency |
